approaches.summary: Codex-native, instruction-first architecture with minimal deterministic state and reversible promotion

finding_dispositions.verification: Static contract check: a repeatably verified local invariant qualifies only within its scope; a joint model-and-prompt change remains provisional; transferable and causal guidance require evidence beyond reviewer assent. Class and rationale are persisted.

Static trace check: repeated partial worker results require unmet-criterion evidence and a causal hypothesis; unchanged indistinguishable failure cannot receive the same dispatch. Finite allowances force a materially changed plan, preserving user model choices and allowing continued distinct safe strategies.

Static trace check: initial no-match followed by a known failure cue triggers retrieval before retry. Unchanged cues/generation avoid reload; changed generations trigger status/qualifier revalidation; selected generation and revisions survive recovery.
Valid authoritative logs can rebuild stale/missing projections; invalid logs pause admission.
Successful, failed, and stopped terminal runs are eligible when integrity-valid and effects are reconciled; active/unknown-effect runs are excluded.

errors.title: Assignment release, resume safety and effect reconciliation disagree about the same recorded facts
errors.reproducer: Run the sandbox probes.py with the recorded sandbox environment. Inspect resume-writer-result-no-terminal, resume-root-failed-unknown, root-failed-unknown-reconciliation, resume-planned-root and two-handles-one-active in results.json. Each directory retains its exact JSONL; resume cases retain agents-input.json. Direct CLI commands are also captured in results.json.
errors.expected: Admission advice and append admission must agree on admitted task revisions, their unresolved effects, and all recorded actors that can still write. A known result alone must not release a delegated writer. Merely planned tasks must not hold a writer barrier. Every accepted unknown-effect state needs an append-only reconciliation route, or a contradictory terminal-result shape must be rejected at ingestion.
errors.actual: A delegated passed/reconciled result with no terminal observation and a missing live handle returns admission_allowed=true while proposing missing/unknown. A root failed/unknown-effect result also returns true; a later failed/reconciled result is rejected as invalid_transition, leaving no root-effect reconciliation path. An unadmitted planned root write returns false. Two agent.requested handles attach to one task, and after agent-a completes while agent-b remains active/unknown, validation accepts admission of a second writer because released() uses any terminal handle.
errors.fix_verification: Retain all five reproductions. Missing/idle/interrupted unreleased delegated writers and root unknown effects must forbid admission; planned and genuinely released root work must permit it. Reject concurrent duplicate ownership or keep every unreconciled handle in the barrier. Show a durable reconciliation path for every accepted unknown-effect result without replacing history. Preserve the existing completed-reader control and both result/observation orderings.

errors.title: A late result for an old revision marks the current unadmitted revision passed
errors.reproducer: python3 sage/scripts/sage_state.py snapshot --run-dir sage/evaluation/sandboxes/sage-a1-r1-critic/late-old-result --write; then run report --write on the same directory. Fixture admits t-1 revision 1, revises its inputs at revision 2, and only then records the revision-1 result.
errors.expected: Retain the late historical result while the current revision-2 task remains planned with no revision-2 result. Reports must not count the revised task as delivered.
errors.actual: The valid hash-bound snapshot contains tasks.t-1.revision=2, state=passed and result.task_revision=1. report.md lists t-1: passed. The projector keys task.result updates only by task_id despite the validator keeping revision-specific results.
errors.fix_verification: Test both a late old result and reconciliation of an old unknown result after a new plan. Snapshot/current report may update only the matching revision, while old facts remain recoverable from immutable history. Verify admission/closure still require the current revision's own result.

errors.title: Ordinary malformed JSON types escape the structured rejection contract and invalid common fields pass
errors.reproducer: Run validate on the enum-array, version-bool, sequence-float and timestamp-invalid directories under the critic sandbox. They differ from a valid run.opened only in type=[], v=true, seq=1.0, or at=2026-99-99T99:99:99Z respectively.
errors.expected: Each input is rejected as a contract/data error, exit 2, with one structured JSON error and no derived-state mutation. Enum fields must be type-checked before hash-set membership; integer and RFC3339 claims must be checked as those types/values.
errors.actual: type=[] produces an uncaught TypeError traceback and exit 1. v=true, seq=1.0 and an impossible calendar/time timestamp validate successfully. Similar unchecked set membership exists in payload enum validation.
errors.fix_verification: Add table-driven wrong-type probes across event kinds and live-agent input, including list/object/null enum values, noninteger common fields and invalid timestamps. Preserve duplicate-key/nonfinite controls and verify invalid append/snapshot inputs preserve existing bytes. Do not mask programmer errors with a blanket success path.

errors.title: Plan revision logic rejects real graph expansion while admitting later initial-labeled retries
errors.reproducer: Validate new-task-only and retry-initial-reason in the critic sandbox. The first retains t-1 and adds t-2 following recorded evidence without changing allowances. The second retries a failed admitted task at revision 2 with reason=initial and no failure cause/evidence/strategy fields.
errors.expected: A genuinely added task counts as an operational graph change. Only the first plan may use initial; a later revision must satisfy its failure, evidence-change or user-amendment reason contract.
errors.actual: The graph expansion fails with no_progress because adding a new task never sets changed=true; changing only no_progress text makes the otherwise identical control pass. The later initial-labeled retry validates and admits its new revision without any causal retry record.
errors.fix_verification: Accept the pure graph-expansion control with unchanged old task revisions. Reject later initial reasons, preserve valid evidence/user-amendment replans without fictitious failures, and retain finite attempt/revision and unchanged-dispatch negatives.

errors.title: Amendment correction links bypass reference validation
errors.reproducer: python3 sage/scripts/sage_state.py snapshot --run-dir sage/evaluation/sandboxes/sage-a1-r1-critic/dangling-amendment --write. The amendment sets corrects_event_id=missing. The valid-amendment-control differs only by pointing at e-1.
errors.expected: Reject a correction that does not reference an earlier event and preserve existing projection bytes; accept the earlier-event control.
errors.actual: Both inputs succeed. The early run.amended branch only adds the event ID to amendments, making the later shared note/amendment correction-reference branch unreachable for amendments.
errors.fix_verification: Validate amendment correction links on every append/validation path. Test missing, future and valid prior IDs, alongside the already covered note correction case.

errors.title: Derived reports erase recorded uncertainty, residual findings and terminal outcome
errors.reproducer: Run report --write for report-omissions and closure-later-failed-check in the critic sandbox. The first records untested mobile-viewport evidence, an accepted minor finding and status=stopped. The second records a later failed integration check after an earlier passed check.
errors.expected: The derived report must show terminal status, untested evidence as well as not_tested checks, accepted residual limitations, and relevant failed checks. It must faithfully surface these recorded facts independently of the root's semantic completion decision.
errors.actual: The first report lists a delivered passed task, Unknowns=None, Untested checks=None and Open findings=None; it omits the stopped outcome, untested viewport and accepted overlap. The second omits the failed integration check. Both show next action close even though their logs are already closed.
errors.fix_verification: Assert report contents against events, not just section headings. Retain terminal outcome, accepted limitations, failed/untested observations and clear terminal next action while keeping observation/inference/unknown distinctions. Failed checks may need root disposition rather than automatic semantic failure, but they must never silently disappear.

errors.title: An early terminal observation becomes irrevocable before the assignment has released
errors.reproducer: Run the r2 sandbox probes.py. For terminal-then-active/idle/interrupted/missing, events first admit w-1 and assign /root/writer, then record completed/reconciled, then a later nonterminal/unknown observation BEFORE the result, and only afterward record the passed/reconciled result. Each probe snapshots, resumes with the matching live lifecycle, and appends admission of w-2. Captured exact commands and outputs are in results.json; each directory retains admission.json and its log.
errors.expected: Before both release facts are established, a newer active or unknown lifecycle must invalidate reliance on an earlier terminal observation, or the contradictory event must be explicitly rejected as requiring reconciliation. Resume and append must keep the writer barrier until a fresh terminal reconciliation. Retain historical fully released assignments without inventing a new barrier merely because a completed worker disappears later.
errors.actual: All four histories validate, their snapshots visibly show the newer active/idle/interrupted/missing unknown state, resume returns admission_allowed=true, and append accepts the second writer. validate and execution_facts ignore every later observation once any completed/reconciled observation appears, even when the task result had not yet arrived. command_resume also derives advice only from those retained old facts. The fresh-terminal control succeeds as it should; properly reassigned same-handle work correctly blocks old-completion reuse.
errors.fix_verification: Add the four preserved orderings and a fresh terminal control. Make release a fact of a fully reconciled assignment, not a permanently absorbing first terminal observation. Current live active/unknown contradictions must not be hidden by a historical terminal fact; separate historical release from latest handle state explicitly. Preserve result-first/observation-first success, historical missing released handles, same-handle fresh assignment barriers and append-only unknown reconciliation.

errors.title: Invalid UTF-8 bypasses structured rejection and prevents repairing a derived snapshot
errors.reproducer: The r2 probes create utf8/invalid.json containing one 0xff byte, then pass it to append --event, resume --agents and init --criteria. They also replace snapshot.json with that byte while preserving a valid events.jsonl, then invoke resume with a valid empty agents array. Exact commands and stderr are in results.json.
errors.expected: Invalid UTF-8 supplied as JSON data returns exit 2 with one JSON data error. Invalid UTF-8 in a derived snapshot must be treated as corrupt/stale and regenerated from the valid authoritative log. Log bytes must remain unchanged. The existing invalid-authoritative-log control must continue to preserve derived bytes.
errors.actual: All four commands exit 1 with uncaught UnicodeDecodeError tracebacks. read_events handles UnicodeDecodeError, but read_json does not; bound_snapshot does not catch it either. Thus corruption confined to a disposable projection blocks the documented valid-log recovery path.
errors.fix_verification: Exercise invalid UTF-8 for criteria, single-event append, live-agent input, authoritative JSONL and derived snapshot. Require structured rejection for input/log cases, successful projection repair for a valid log plus bad snapshot, and unchanged authoritative bytes throughout. Preserve existing wrong-type, duplicate-key and nonfinite controls.

errors.expected: Admission advice and append admission must agree on admitted task revisions, their unresolved effects, and all recorded actors that can still write. A known result alone must not release a delegated writer. Merely planned tasks must not hold a writer barrier. Every accepted unknown-effect state needs an append-only reconciliation route, or a contradictory terminal-result shape must be rejected at ingestion.
errors.actual: A delegated passed/reconciled result with no terminal observation and a missing live handle returns admission_allowed=true while proposing missing/unknown. An unadmitted planned root write returns false. Two agent.requested handles attach to one task, and after agent-a completes while agent-b remains active/unknown, validation accepts admission of a second writer because released() uses any terminal handle.
errors.fix_verification: Retain all five reproductions. Missing/idle/interrupted unreleased delegated writers and root unknown effects must forbid admission; planned and genuinely released root work must permit it. Reject concurrent duplicate ownership or keep every unreconciled handle in the barrier. Show a durable reconciliation path for every accepted unknown-effect result without replacing history. Preserve the existing completed-reader control and both result/observation orderings.
